snippet.title: Exactly 4 Litres 💧 Riddle #10 Answer + Riddle #11: 8 Balls, 1 Heavy, 2 Weighings ⚖️ #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's jugs: a 3-litre jug and a 5-litre jug. How do you get exactly 4 litres?

Answer: Fill the 5. Pour it into the 3, so 2 litres stay in the 5. Empty the 3 and pour the 2 litres in. Fill the 5 again and top up the 3: only 1 more litre fits. Exactly 4 litres are left in the 5-litre jug!

Riddle #11 ⚖️
Person 1 has 8 balls that look exactly the same, but one is a little heavier. Person 1 has a balance scale and can use it only TWO times. How can Person 1 find the heavy ball, for sure?

Comment your answer 👇 The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
